# Licence for the vendored DTCG test suite fixtures

The `format/` directory next to this file is an unmodified copy of
`test-suite/tests/2025.10/format/` from the Design Tokens Community Group
repository, pinned at commit `882ebd6716abef9a46d8ef5fb12e82009d6cee2e`:

https://github.com/design-tokens/community-group/tree/882ebd6716abef9a46d8ef5fb12e82009d6cee2e/test-suite/tests/2025.10/format

> Contributions to Test Suites and Other Software are made under the
> [W3C 3-clause BSD License](https://www.w3.org/Consortium/Legal/2008/03-bsd-license.html)

their contributors. The licence text follows, as published at

This licence covers `format/` only. Every other file in this directory belongs
